items.title: Why Seagate Stock And AI Data Center Demand Are Back On Investors Radar
items.summary: AI infrastructure is suddenly more than a tech story; it is a macro force touching GDP, household wealth, and the mood of the whole market. With the S&P and Nasdaq both well off recent highs, the same theme that lifted portfolios could now sharpen both upside and risk. This article walks through three AI Infrastructure Enablers from our screener that appear positively exposed to the latest news shock. The three stocks highlighted below are only a sample. items.title: Micron Is Down 32% in a Month. Can MU Stock Get Back to $1,000?
items.summary: A 12% single-day plunge has wiped out billions in Micron's value just as UBS questions whether AI spending can ever pay for itself. The memory giant's bulls have committed shipments on their side, but one upcoming test could decide everything.

items.title: Western Digital Stock Falls 12% in the Memory Chip Selloff. It Spun Off Its Flash Business Last Year and Now Sits 65% Below Its Record
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) fell 12% to about $261 on Friday as the AI chip selloff hit memory and storage stocks for a second day. The hard drive maker spun off its flash business in 2025, is 65% below its June record and trades at about 20 times trailing adjusted earnings.

items.title: Western Digital Cratered 40% in The Last 3 Months: This Wall Street Desk Now Predicts 200% Returns After Raising Its Target Price
items.summary: Western Digital keeps posting record results and analysts keep raising estimates, yet the stock keeps sliding. One Wall Street desk sees a rebound far bigger than the rest, and the reason may lie in a corner of the AI buildout most investors ignore.

items.title: Micron Stock Plunges 13% as Barron’s Calls Memory Stocks ‘Agonizingly Cheap’; Western Digital, SanDisk and Seagate Sink in AI Chip Selloff
items.summary: Micron fell 13% on Friday and sits 50% below its June record as Barron's calls memory stocks "agonizingly cheap." The stock's last two busts ended after drops of 50% and 54%. Here is the case for and against.

items.title: SanDisk Stock Has Pulled Back. Here’s Where Shares Could Be Headed Next
items.summary: SanDisk has lost more than a third of its value in a month, even as earnings beats keep stacking up. One forecasting model sees a wide gap between the price and the business, and a stock split is about to put it under a microscope.

items.title: What a Market ‘Correction’ Actually Means
items.summary: Despite Anthropic's record-breaking IPO yesterday, the AI juggernaut couldn't save the AI trade.

items.title: Hard Drives Were Left for Dead, But Seagate and Western Digital Are Soaring
items.summary: AI-driven data storage demand is fueling rallies in Seagate (STX) and Western Digital (WDC), as both HDD makers report surging revenue, margins, and differing technology strategies.
